title: Dizayn qanday konversiya beradi: Bizning yondashuv
author: Seraphim
teaser: Veb-saytingiz sizning brendingiz haqida mijozda birinchi taassurot qoldiradi. Yaxshi dizayn shunchaki chiroyli ko'rinish emas; u ishonch va sotuvlarni oshiradi.
body:
A B2B website can make or break your business in 2026. Did you know that 94% of internet users prioritize easy navigation? Or that 83% find an updated, well-designed website more appealing? Half of all consumers judge a company’s credibility based on its website design. That’s why having a professional, impactful website isn’t lovely but also very essential.

Your website often gives potential clients the first impression of your brand. A good design doesn’t look great; it builds trust, drives engagement, and boosts conversions. Today, we’ve rounded up the best B2B website design strategies in 2026. These approaches are redefining web design, helping businesses stand out and succeed. Are you ready to choose the perfect partner for your needs?

### Form and Function
A design must consider both form and function. Our proficiency in B2B website design allows us to expertly organize complicated data intuitively, which makes it easy for decision-makers to navigate. DID90° focuses on building effective information architecture to organize content efficiently and enhance usability and navigation within digital products.

title: Digital olamni zabt etish: Zamonaviy strategiya
author: Seraphim
teaser: Kuchli kontent strategiyasi sizning qidiruv tizimlaridagi ko'rinuvchanligingizni belgilaydi. 2026-yilda B2B kompaniyalar uchun 7 ta asosiy ustun.
body:
A robust content strategy can make or break your online visibility in 2026. Did you know that 94% of B2B marketers use content marketing to generate leads? Or that 83% of consumers prefer learning about a company through content rather than traditional advertising? Half of all internet traffic goes to the first page of search results. That’s why having a professional, impactful content strategy isn't lovely but also very essential.

Your content often gives potential clients the first impression of your brand and expertise. A good strategy doesn’t just look great; it builds authority, drives organic traffic, and boosts conversions by answering user needs.

### 7 Core Pillars of a Modern Content Strategy
1. Deep Audience Profiling (The Intent Pillar)
2. Effective Keyword Research and Mapping
3. The E-E-A-T Principle (Expertise, Experience, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness)
4. Multi-Format Content Delivery
5. Internal and External Linking Strategy
6. Consistent Content Auditing
7. Clear Calls to Action (CTAs) and Conversions
